Recipe plus missing cards: Slice and Dice OTK Rogue

Recipe plus missing cards: Drake Warlock

Recipe plus missing cards: Dragon Shreds Warlock
Crack The Egg of Khelos while gaining armor and drawing. Extra copies of Endbringer Umbra repeat the hatch into more giant Taunts.
Recipe plus missing cards: Khelos Egg Warrior
Collect Blood Fighters and trade into a chain of larger summons. Each Deathrattle pulls the next threat straight from your hand.
Recipe plus missing cards: Lo'Gosh Warrior

Recipe plus missing cards: Spell Damage Burn Warrior
Recruit large minions with Gladiatorial Combat. Copy and revive The Great Dracorex to clear enemy boards and keep attacking.
Recipe plus missing cards: Gladiator Recruit Warrior

CosmeticsSource.Verification: Items with verify=true await native check; after live smoke set verify=false per item. Generator preserves flags.
CosmeticsSource.PriceHistoryRule: Append-only; regeneration keeps every earlier price. Receipts paid at any listed price stay valid.
CosmeticsSource.LadderSelection: Owner may swap. No seasonal metal names; seven most recent SEASON records by data1, assigned oldest to newest. Never sold; milestones never time-limited.

HubCosmeticsSource.Verification: verify=true items await a live check (theme viewed at HUB; board loaded in a real match); set verify=false per item after it passes.
HubCosmeticsSource.Themes: Native BoxDressing library names (docs/roadmap/2026-10-25-menu-themes-feasibility.md); Classic and Random owned are free.
HubCosmeticsSource.Boards: Constructed BOARD rows; boards 1-7 and Random owned are free. Battlegrounds, Mercenaries, tutorial/encounter and Green Screen boards are excluded.

NotForSale.BLACKEMPIRE: Release meta is pre-Black Empire (owner 2026-10-25); kept in plugin data, not sold yet.
NotForSale.TEST_EVENT: Dev alias of Cataclysm; never sold.

PendingOwnerReview.WINTER_VEIL: Loads (lane 2, 2026-10-25) but offline only adds falling snow to the classic box; verify=true until the owner accepts it at 1000 gold.
PendingOwnerReview.FIRE_FESTIVAL: Loads (lane 2, 2026-10-25) but offline only adds embers to the classic box; verify=true until the owner accepts it at 1000 gold.
PendingOwnerReview.CATCH_UP_WILD_WEST: Loads (lane 2, 2026-10-25) but offline only adds light streaks and a drawer frame; verify=true until the owner accepts it at 1000 gold.

PetsSource.GrowthRule: 100 local XP for a finished Won/Lost/Tied match of at least four engine turns without conceding; no XP for abandoned/cancelled matches.
